product.name: Photoroom AI Photo Editor and Listing Studio
product.description: An AI-powered image editing and listing-creation platform for producing product photos, marketplace listings, social content, ads, and other business visuals.

product.name: AI Product Photography
product.description: A set of AI capabilities for converting ordinary product images into professional product visuals, including generated scenes, virtual models, backgrounds, and studio-style enhancements.

product.name: Photoroom Batch
product.description: A bulk image-editing capability for processing large volumes of product images with consistent edits, formats, and visual treatments.

product.name: Photoroom API
product.description: An API-driven image-editing service that lets businesses integrate Photoroom’s image processing and product-visual workflows into their own applications and operations.

product.name: Photoroom Brand Kit and Teams
product.description: Collaboration and brand-management functionality for sharing logos, colors, templates, and designs to produce consistent on-brand visuals across a team.

product.name: Photoroom Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise offering that provides Photoroom’s visual-creation capabilities for established organizations requiring team workflows, custom integrations, reliability, and administrative control.
